name: Logical Implication of Transposition Invariance
description: Removed the explanatory note that explicitly translated the invariance condition into a graph connectivity property with intermediate hubs. Refined the objective condition to use rigorous mathematical logic ("is necessarily indifferent (as a logical consequence)") instead of vague terms like "analytically," relying entirely on the formal definition of coordinate transposition invariance to implicitly encode the Steiner tree requirement without giving away the underlying graph structure.
